info.name: NC Office Launcher
info.summary: One-click launchers for Writer, Calc and Impress in the App Menu
info.description: Adds three dedicated navigation entries – Text Document, Spreadsheet, and Presentation – to the Nextcloud top-level app launcher (waffle menu). Clicking an entry automatically creates a timestamped blank file in the user's root folder and opens it instantly in Collabora Online (richdocuments).
